from nlx.monthly_active_jobs
union all
select
  'USAJOBS' as corpus,
  min(month_start) as first_month,
  max(month_start) as last_month,
  count(*) as n_months,
  sum(monthly_active_jobs) as monthly_active_jobs
from usajobs.monthly_active_jobs
order by corpus
